function.name: version_api_VersionApi_get_version
function.description: Retrieve the current version of the application, including its name and version number in a JSON format. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

function.name: oidc_api_OidcApi_is_available
function.description: Checks if OpenID Connect authentication is supported for the current application, which enables single sign-on capabilities. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

application_id.description: The unique identifier of the application for which to check OpenID Connect availability.

function.name: project_api_ProjectApi_update_project
function.description: Updates the specified attributes of a project based on the provided project ID. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

project_id.description: The unique identifier of the project to be updated.

project_data.description: A dictionary containing key-value pairs of the project attributes to be updated.

name.description: The new name of the project.

description.description: The new description of the project.

status.description: The new status of the project.

deadline.description: The updated project completion deadline in 'YYYY-MM-DD' format.

function.name: project_api_ProjectApi_get_project_by_name_and_version
function.description: Retrieve details of a specific project identified by a combination of its name and version. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

name.description: The unique name of the project.

version.description: The specific version of the project, following semantic versioning, such as '1.0.0'.

function.name: repository_api_RepositoryApi_get_repository_meta_component
function.description: Resolves the latest version of a specified component from the configured repositories. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

purl.description: The Package URL (PURL) for the component whose latest version needs to be resolved.

include_prereleases.description: Flag to include pre-release versions in the resolution process.
